subject.title: Create Claw agent and root install record

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor the consented, persistent `claws add` lifecycle as a core experimental feature and land this stacked mutation slice after its prerequisite?
rationale: The patch introduces a new public CLI mutation mode, persistent install-record model, and recovery contract; implementation quality cannot decide whether that product and ownership surface belongs in core or remains dry-run-only.

options.title: Sponsor the staged core lifecycle
options.body: Approve the core direction, land the prerequisite first, then require current-head interrupted-install recovery proof before merging this mutation slice.

options.title: Retain planning only
options.body: Keep the existing experimental workflow dry-run-only until maintainers define the full install, status, remove, migration, and recovery product contract.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Request a smaller, explicitly bounded core seam if only part of the proposed lifecycle is intended for OpenClaw rather than the full installer state machine.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the staged core lifecycle
recommendation.body: Approve the core direction, land the prerequisite first, then require current-head interrupted-install recovery proof before merging this mutation slice.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline explicitly routes this stacked RFC-derived core direction to steipete, though the supplied history does not prove exclusive ownership.
